content.title: Add a task
content.description: A user adds a new task to the todo list by entering a task title and submitting it with Enter, with the source defining the title input and Enter key submission as the promised creation path.
content.summary: Create a new task from a typed title.
content.value: Lets users capture a new todo item in the list with minimal effort.
criteria: A task is added from a typed task title when the user presses Enter.
